verdict.rationale: Drata publishes the source of one first-party component, the Drata Agent desktop app, in a public GitHub repo with local build instructions, so part of the product's source is readable. The evidence never states the repo's license, and nothing shows the core SaaS compliance platform's source is available. Missing for 10: evidence of an open-source license on the agent repo, source availability for the core Drata platform, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
